candidate.title: EmbedController authorization can be bypassed by forging the Referer header
reports: app/controllers/embedcontroller.rb:61 — ensureembeddable authorizes the entire embedcontroller (comments/count, csrf-exempt via skipbeforefilter :verifyauthenticitytoken) solely by checking embeddablehost.hostallowed?(request.referer), but the referer header is fully attacker-controlled from any non-browser http client (curl/requests/postman), so anyone can forge referer: http://<allowed-host>/ to bypass the embeddable-host restriction entirely and pull topic content directly, defeating the feature's only access-control guarantee .

[advisory] the rewritten ensureembeddable still authorizes the anonymous embed endpoints solely on the client-supplied referer header (embeddablehost.hostallowed?(request.referer)), so forging referer: http://<allowed-host>/ is sufficient to read any embedded topic's comment stream. anyone who learns a single allowed hostname can curl the embed endpoints with a fabricated referer and read the full comment stream of every embedded topic without placing anything on the allowed host, defeating the host allowlist as an access boundary and enabling off-site scraping of reply content.
